message: Cannot serialize the compile-time value of type '{0}' to a run-time value because it contains a cyclic reference or is nested more than 32 levels deep.
title: A compile-time value contains a cyclic reference or is nested too deeply.
rationale: Incorrect: SyntaxSerializationContext.WithSerializeObject does not detect cycles; it throws when the serialization recursion exceeds 32 levels, so a deeply nested value without any cycle also triggers the error. The title 'A collection contains itself.' is also too narrow for the same reason.
codeChange: SyntaxSerializationContext.WithSerializeObject (SyntaxSerializationContext.cs, line 74) passes typeof(T), the static type of the nested call, which is 'Object' for any element of a collection (ListSerializer, ArraySerializer and DictionarySerializer call Serialize<object>). Pass o?.GetType() instead, or better, the type of the root value being converted.
